segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמַּקִּיף אֶת חֲבֵירוֹ מִשָּׁלֹשׁ רוּחוֹתָיו, וְגָדַר אֶת הָרִאשׁוֹנָה וְאֶת הַשְּׁנִיָּה וְאֶת הַשְּׁלִישִׁית – אֵין מְחַיְּיבִין אוֹתוֹ. רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר: אִם עָמַד וְגָדַר אֶת הָרְבִיעִית – מְגַלְגְּלִין עָלָיו אֶת הַכֹּל.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «one who surrounds another on three sides,» that is, he owns parcels of land on three sides of the other person’s field, «and he built a partition» on «the first, the second, and the third» sides, the court «does not obligate» the neighbor who owns the inner field to contribute to the construction of the partition if he does not wish to do so. «Rabbi Yosei says: If he arose and built a partition» on «the fourth» side of the field, the court «imposes upon» the owner of the inner field the responsibility to pay his share for «all» of the partitions.

moves.summary: fencing the fourth side imposes all
